OpenVireo core for Java (b56056f2e6c8)

The OpenVireo core for Java 11+ on macOS, Linux and Windows (com.openvireo:openvireo-core-jvm): accounts, vaults, sync, share links and .kdbx files, on the same Rust code as the OpenVireo apps.

From Java, start with com.openvireo.core.java: JOvClient, JAccount, JVault return CompletableFutures, and JOv has the free functions. The records, enums and errors they take and return are in com.openvireo.core. Guide: Kotlin and Java. The same API in Kotlin: Kotlin reference.

Generated from openvireo-core at commit b56056f2e6c81d984c72ef8f3aae3f0a42fc8c43.

Package
Description
com.openvireo.core
The binding itself, generated by UniFFI from the ov-ffi crate: OvClient, Account, Vault, ServiceAccount, SelfHosted, the records and enums they take and return, the Host interfaces (HttpTransport, SecureStore, BlobCache, Clock, LogSink), OvException and the free functions (crypto, share links, TOTP, OPAQUE).
com.openvireo.core.hosts
Ready-made Host parts and defaultHost(...), so a program needs no glue: JavaNetHttpTransport, UrlConnectionTransport, MemoryStore, FileCache, MemoryCache, SystemClock, JulLogSink.
com.openvireo.core.java
The API for Java, without coroutines: J<Object> wrappers (JOvClient, JAccount, JVault, ...) whose suspend methods return CompletableFuture, JOv (every free function as a static), JRecords (records with unsigned fields), JErrors, and the future-based Host interfaces with JHosts and JDefaultHosts.
